hzd-plugin.plugin.name: HZD Administration
hzd-plugin.homepage.title: HZD Administration
hzd-plugin.homepage.description: Tools and reports for HZD administration processes.
hzd-plugin.reports.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the report window.
hzd-plugin.reports.users.title: User Report
hzd-plugin.reports.users.description: Checks breeder owner members for missing publishMyData.
hzd-plugin.reports.users.error: The user report could not be generated.
hzd-plugin.reports.breeders.title: Breeder Report
hzd-plugin.reports.breeders.description: Checks active, non-disabled breeders for missing owner members.
hzd-plugin.reports.breeders.error: The breeder report could not be generated.
hzd-plugin.litterReminder.title: Litter reminder
hzd-plugin.litterReminder.description: Sends an email to the breeder of every litter in status Littered whose date of birth is more than the selected number of weeks ago.
hzd-plugin.litterReminder.error: The litter reminders could not be sent.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.title: Process Chromosoft data
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.description: Processes CS_Member and CS_Dog, then updates stud dogs and assigns breeder groups.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.abortError: The import could not be cancelled.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.membersHint: Writes the current CS_Member generation into users. Breeders are not created as users. A missing breeder with the same cId is created.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.dogsHint: Writes the current CS_Dog generation into dogs.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.studDogsHin: Updates stud-dog profiles of fertile males from their owner. With "Fix groups" the owner is added to the dr-besitzer group.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.breedersHin: With "Fix groups", owner members of breeders (role B) join the zuechter group and owner members of stud dogs (role S) join the dr-besitzer group.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.fixedUsersH: Sets publishMyData for every owner member. With "Fix groups", adds them to the breeder group unless CS_Member.PersonIsABreeder is true.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.success: Chromosoft data processed: {members} members, {dogs} dogs, {studDogs} stud dogs, {breeders} breeders, {fixedUsers} users checked.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.successSkip: Chromosoft data processed: {members} members ({memberSkipped} unchanged), {dogs} dogs ({dogSkipped} unchanged), {studDogs} stud dogs, {breeders} breeders, {fixedUsers} users checked.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.error: The Chromosoft data could not be imported.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.logError: The log file could not be downloaded.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.config.intr: Controls how an existing record is changed on update. New records are always filled completely. "Do not overwrite" keeps the value. "Overwrite when empty" writes only when the field is empty or null. "Overwrite" replaces the value with the import. An empty import value clears a field only when the import sets that explicitly. The setting applies from the next import.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.config.save: The field configuration could not be saved.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.config.zuec: These fields are written by "Process CS_Member". "Update breeders" does not change them and only assigns user groups.
hzd-plugin.chromosoft.import.config.stud: These fields are written by "Update stud dogs". cPhone and cBreederEmail are written by "Process CS_Member" when the owner already has role S.
hzd-plugin.searchIndex.title: Search
hzd-plugin.searchIndex.description: Reindexes published pages and news articles. Pages with a restriction and Public = false are skipped.
hzd-plugin.searchIndex.error: The full reindex could not be started.
